meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 会变成 NanoClaw 的定制助手:它会先问你想要什么改动,然后帮你规划并实施——比如接入新的聊天渠道、修改触发规则、添加集成等,还会告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 增加新渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)、修改触发规则、添加集成,或做其他定制时触发。

say.text: 我想给 NanoClaw 接入 Telegram 作为输入渠道
say.note: Claude 会询问细节并帮你添加渠道。

say.text: 帮我改一下触发规则,让特定词唤醒另一个 agent group
say.note: Claude 会更新 wiring 的触发规则。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个 Google 日历集成
say.note: Claude 会检查有无现成工具并帮你配置。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude acts as an interactive customization assistant for NanoClaw: it asks what you want to change, then plans and implements it (adding channels, changing triggers, adding integrations) and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to add an input channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change trigger rules, add integrations, or make other customizations to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: I want to add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions and help you add the channel.

say_en.text: Change the trigger rules so a specific word wakes another agent group.
say_en.note: Claude will update the wiring trigger rules.

say_en.text: Add a Google Calendar integration to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude will check for a ready-made tool and configure it.
